tools.name: load_toolset
tools.title: Load a toolset
tools.description: Enable an additional group of fabdesk tools for this session. Available toolsets are project, circuit, route, kicad, verify, render, export, sim, app, and shopping (fabplane.com shopping list and team inventory). Core tools are always available.

tools.name: pcb_environment
tools.title: Inspect the PCB workbench and script interface
tools.description: Return current project paths, kicad-cli identity, FabPCB bridge status, desktop-UI availability, and available interfaces.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: project_status
tools.title: Project status
tools.description: Summarise the selected project: directory, board settings, native KiCad files, latest source/compiler build, persisted release evidence and staleness, route and verification state, sketches, and reports. Does not run ERC, DRC, or release.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: circuit_build
tools.title: Build the board
tools.description: Compile circuit.netlist.json into board.kicad_pcb and a generated board.kicad_sch. Footprints are pulled from KiCad libraries, explicitly placed when board.placements names them, and connected into the ratsnest; libSource draws searchable schematic symbols with labelled wire stubs. Returns actionable errors/warnings. Rebuilds replace only generated schematic items, preserve manual schematic work and unlisted manual footprint placement, keep tracks whose nets still exist, and remove footprints the netlist no longer names.

entrypoint.description: Netlist file relative to the project, default circuit.netlist.json

rebuild.description: preserve keeps compatible existing copper; clean removes routed tracks/arcs/vias after source validation before rebuilding

fresh.description: Discard the existing board first (outline, placement, tracks) and build from the netlist alone. Needed after changing the board size: a build never redraws an outline that exists.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: circuit_place
tools.title: Place footprints
tools.description: Move built-board footprints to explicit KiCad board coordinates in millimetres, with optional rotation. Tracks are not moved. Returns moved and missing references.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: circuit_read_errors
tools.title: Read build errors
tools.description: Return errors and warnings from reports/build.json.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: route_run
tools.title: Autoroute the board
tools.description: Start a durable asynchronous autoroute against a revision-bound board snapshot and return a run ID immediately. Progress, diagnostics and artifacts remain available through route_status after this request ends. applyPolicy=auto (default) atomically applies only while the starting PCB revision is current; manual preserves a validated native candidate for route_apply. onlyConnections limits the run to named nets.

router.description: Router; defaults to the project's fabdesk.json router

onlyConnections.description: Route only these leftover nets. The DSN network lists just those nets; other copper stays as obstacles. Via padstacks include existing board via sizes so sessions round-trip. If nothing routes, the result lists the leftover pads.

targets.description: Selected nets or exact remaining endpoint pairs

rules.description: Explicit routing width, clearance, via and zone rules; the router uses the board's enabled copper layers

applyPolicy.description: auto applies only if the starting PCB revision is still current; manual preserves a candidate for route_apply

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: verify_drc
tools.title: Run KiCad DRC
tools.description: Run KiCad design rule check on board.kicad_pcb. When parity is enabled, require a complete saved schematic hierarchy and bind parity evidence to its aggregate revision. Writes reports/drc.json with actionable geometry.

severity.description: Report all severities or errors only

limit.description: Max violations per category in the response (maximum 200). Every violation is in reports/drc.json regardless; this only bounds the inline sample.

responseMode.description: summary: counts, per-rule totals and a byte-bounded sample without per-violation geometry rows. full: the complete enriched violations inline, which costs roughly 1 KiB per violation.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: render_board
tools.title: Render board image
tools.description: Render a PNG of the KiCad board (top or bottom, raytraced optional) to renders/<view>.png and return it as an image so you can inspect placement and routing. Requires kicad-cli and circuit_build.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: project_read_file
tools.title: Read a project file
tools.description: Read a text file inside the project directory. Paths are relative to the project and may not leave it. Binary files are reported by size only; project_list_sketches returns image content.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: project_write_file
tools.title: Write a project file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a UTF-8 text file inside the project directory. Paths are relative to the project and may not leave it; fabdesk.json is managed by project_set_board.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: project_list_sketches
tools.title: List sketches
tools.description: List PNG, JPEG, and SVG files under sketches/ with absolute paths and image content for raster formats.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: project_set_board
tools.title: Set board settings
tools.description: Update fabdesk.json board settings: layer count, outline dimensions, router, and optional prefab blank template. template="viagrid-9055" represents the Opulo 90 x 55 mm blank with its factory vias, mounting holes, and 0.2 mm track and clearance rules; template="none" removes the template.

template.description: Prefab blank to design on; viagrid-9055 or none

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: project_import_kicad
tools.title: Adopt a KiCad board
tools.description: Copy an existing .kicad_pcb and adjacent .kicad_pro/.kicad_sch files into the canonical project paths. The imported board becomes the project design. Also records its copper-layer count when kicad-cli is available.

path.description: Absolute path to the .kicad_pcb, or a path relative to the project

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: circuit_query
tools.title: Query the board
tools.description: List board contents from KiCad as a compact table: components, nets, pads, vias, tracks, unrouted connections, or the board outline. Supports an optional substring filter.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: circuit_search_parts
tools.title: Search KiCad libraries
tools.description: Search the KiCad symbol or footprint libraries available to the native design server. Returns exact library identifiers, descriptions, and role suitability for native schematic and PCB operations.

role.description: Optional functional role used to rank matching parts

tools.name: circuit_describe_part
tools.title: Describe a KiCad part
tools.description: Return details for one exact KiCad symbol or footprint. Symbols include pin numbers, names and electrical types; footprints include pad numbers, anchor-relative positions and sizes in millimetres.

tools.name: circuit_check_part_compatibility
tools.title: Check symbol and footprint compatibility
tools.description: Read-only pre-placement check for one exact KiCad symbol/footprint pair. Reports pin-to-pad mappings, mechanical/fabrication facts, and optional role suitability without modifying a project.

tools.name: design_inspect
tools.title: Inspect saved native design
tools.description: Inspect the exact complete saved schematic hierarchy and board revision in one result. Defaults to compact whole-project schematic truth; optionally expands one sheet's live KiCad IPC authoring details. Saved-file ERC/parity and live session diagnostics remain separately labelled. mechanical=true adds per-footprint 3D model coverage, board-space bounds, heights, assembly bounds and broad-phase overlap candidates measured from the packaged runtime.

refreshChecks.description: Run packaged-kicad-cli full-severity ERC and parity-enabled DRC for these exact saved files

responseMode.description: Return the complete inspection inline, or a bounded reference to the complete saved report

mechanical.description: Measure per-footprint 3D model coverage, transformed bounds and heights with packaged kicad-cli (cached by PCB and model-file content)

sheet.description: Sheet path, name, or native filename for bounded authoring expansion

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: pcb_inspect
tools.title: Inspect a PCB region
tools.description: Inspect a bounded part of the saved native PCB by item kind, reference, net, layer, rectangle, or point/radius. Layers accept F.Cu, BL_F_Cu, or the KiCad enum number (3); vias occupy every copper layer they span. board_geometry returns board-owned outline and graphic shapes; request footprint_geometry explicitly for footprint-owned courtyard and fabrication primitives, and include zones to see pour occupancy. islandsOfNet returns the copper islands of those nets (pad/via/track/zone connectivity). Returns compact exact millimetre coordinates, AABB, source revision, bounds, and a truncation indicator.

region.description: Inclusive PCB rectangle in millimetres. Items are matched by their body, not their centre: a pad or via whose copper reaches into the rectangle is reported, and a zone covering it is reported. Pad rows carry no rotation, so a pad is matched by its largest dimension in both axes — occupancy is never under-reported and a long thin pad may be reported conservatively.

near.description: Items touching this point/radius in millimetres

islandsOfNet.description: Return connected copper islands for these nets (pad/via/track/zone graph)

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.description: Preview or atomically apply explicit native KiCad schematic, footprint, outline, copper, zone, keepout, text, and graphic changes. Revision mismatches reject the transaction; rejected changes restore the prior files.

end.description: Exact millimetre point or a footprint pad resolved to its exact saved-board position

KiCad layer name such as F.Cu, B.Cu, F.SilkS, B.SilkS, or Edge.Cuts; numeric IDs remain accepted

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: native_edit_rollback
tools.title: Rollback the last accepted native edit
tools.description: Restore the exact native KiCad files saved before an accepted native_edit_transaction. The current revisions must still match that transaction's after revisions, preventing rollback over newer work.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: pcb_edit_copper
tools.title: Atomically edit PCB copper
tools.description: Atomically validate and apply native tracks, vias, copper deletion by inspected ID, or removal of named routed nets in one recoverable transaction. The normal mode=apply path validates before saving and restores prior files if rejected; use mode=preview only when a non-mutating forecast is specifically needed. For reroutes, write a project-local JSON candidate and pass candidateFile with removeNets so old copper is replaced in one recoverable transaction. Applying named-net removal without replacement requires an explicit commitRemovalOnly acknowledgement. Track endpoints accept exact millimetre points or semantic {reference,pad} endpoints resolved from the saved board. Rejects stale PCB revisions.

start.description: Exact millimetre point or a footprint pad resolved to its exact saved-board position

end.description: Exact millimetre point or a footprint pad resolved to its exact saved-board position

layer.description: KiCad layer name such as F.Cu, B.Cu, F.SilkS, B.SilkS, or Edge.Cuts; numeric IDs remain accepted

items.description: KiCad layer name such as F.Cu, B.Cu, F.SilkS, B.SilkS, or Edge.Cuts; numeric IDs remain accepted

candidateFile.description: Project-relative JSON file containing {tracks:[...], vias:[...]}; keeps large generated routes durable and out of the tool-call payload

commitRemovalOnly.description: Explicitly acknowledge that named-net copper removal should persist without replacement geometry

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: pcb_edit_graphics
tools.title: Atomically edit PCB outline and graphics
tools.description: Atomically validate and apply a native board outline, zones, keepouts, text, graphics, or deletion by inspected ID in one recoverable transaction. The normal mode=apply path validates before saving and restores prior files if rejected; use mode=preview only when a non-mutating forecast is specifically needed. Uses millimetres and rejects stale PCB revisions.

items.description: KiCad layer name such as F.Cu, B.Cu, F.SilkS, B.SilkS, or Edge.Cuts; numeric IDs remain accepted
KiCad layer name such as F.Cu, B.Cu, F.SilkS, B.SilkS, or Edge.Cuts; numeric IDs remain accepted

layer.description: KiCad layer name such as F.Cu, B.Cu, F.SilkS, B.SilkS, or Edge.Cuts; numeric IDs remain accepted

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: schematic_inspect
tools.title: Inspect native schematic
tools.description: Inspect the complete saved native schematic hierarchy. The default is a compact packaged-KiCad project summary; request authoring or full for bounded live KiCad IPC details on the root/current or one selected sheet. Live session diagnostics are never presented as saved-file ERC.

detail.description: summary=count/check overview; authoring=symbols and pins; full=all wires, labels, nets and deletion IDs

sheet.description: For authoring/full detail, select one hierarchy path, sheet name, or native filename

sheetOffset.description: First hierarchy summary sheet to return

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: schematic_edit
tools.title: Edit native schematic
tools.description: Apply one undoable edit batch directly to board.kicad_sch. Supports rotated or mirrored library symbols, symbol movement, safely labelled pin stubs, explicit wires, local and global labels, junctions, no-connect markers, notes, and deletion by inspected ID. Creates native KiCad files when absent. Coordinates are millimetres on KiCad's 1.27 mm schematic grid.

libId.description: Exact KiCad symbol ID, such as Device:R

reference.description: Unique annotated reference, such as R1

footprint.description: Exact KiCad footprint ID; omit or use an empty string for non-physical symbols such as power flags

nodes.description: Symbol pin endpoints joined electrically by matching labels on short visible wire stubs

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: schematic_review
tools.title: Review schematic quality
tools.description: Review one explicitly scoped live KiCad sheet for presentation and maintainability findings, while binding the report to the complete saved hierarchy revision. Writes reports/schematic-review.json without changing native files.

sheet.description: Hierarchy path, sheet name, or native filename; default is the current/root sheet

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: pcb_update_from_schematic
tools.title: Atomically update PCB from schematic
tools.description: Atomically validate and run KiCad's native Update PCB from Schematic. The normal apply=true path performs its own dry-run validation, requires zero PCB↔schematic parity conflicts, and saves the PCB only on success. Use apply=false only when a forecast without PCB changes is specifically needed. Both modes save the live schematic before checking it. Live-session diagnostic errors block the board update but are not saved-file or release-authoritative ERC. Board-only footprints are preserved by default.

apply.description: True atomically validates, applies, and saves the PCB; false previews without changing the PCB (both save the live schematic)

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: pcb_define_outline
tools.title: Define PCB outline
tools.description: Create a native board.kicad_pcb outer Edge.Cuts boundary. Give widthMm/heightMm for a rectangle at (0,0), or at least three polygon points in mm. Re-running accepts an exact match. replace=true updates only an outline previously created by this tool; a different existing outline fails closed.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: pcb_place
tools.title: Place PCB footprints
tools.description: Place native PCB footprints and adjust their silkscreen reference fields at explicit millimetre coordinates. Library geometry is normalized before reference-field edits. Unknown references fail without a partial placement.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: route_status
tools.title: Routing status
tools.description: Return compact persisted progress, heartbeat freshness, revision match, candidate/application state and artifact paths for the latest or exact durable route run.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: route_cancel
tools.title: Cancel routing
tools.description: Idempotently request cancellation of one exact durable route run. It never cancels a different project or newer run.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: route_apply
tools.title: Apply route candidate
tools.description: Atomically apply one validated route candidate only when the supplied expected PCB revision equals both the current board and the run's starting revision. Restores the prior board on validation failure.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: route_unroute
tools.title: Remove routed tracks
tools.description: Delete routed tracks, arcs and vias from the board — all of them or only the named nets. One undo entry in KiCad.

connections.description: Net names to unroute; omit for all

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: route_scope
tools.title: Nets attached to components
tools.description: List the nets attached to component references (e.g. the footprints a repair touches). Nets that own a copper pour are excluded by default and listed with the reason.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: kicad_stats
tools.title: Board statistics
tools.description: Board statistics from KiCad: outline size, layer count, footprint/pad/track/via counts, drill sizes. Requires kicad-cli and board.kicad_pcb.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: verify_erc
tools.title: Run KiCad ERC
tools.description: Run packaged kicad-cli electrical rule check on the complete saved schematic hierarchy, bind it to the aggregate revision of every referenced native sheet, write qualified evidence to reports/erc.json, and return counts and violations.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: verify_gate
tools.title: Release gate
tools.description: Evaluate the release gate over saved-file reports/drc.json and packaged-kicad-cli reports/erc.json evidence. The result includes pass status, failure reasons, and warning signatures. acceptWarnings adds current warning signatures to fabdesk.json allowedDrcWarnings.

acceptWarnings.description: Add the current new warning signatures to the allowed baseline

requireErc.description: Fail when no ERC report exists

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: verify_viagrid
tools.title: Check the Viagrid rules
tools.description: For a project on a Viagrid 9055 blank (project_set_board template=viagrid-9055): reads the vias and pads from the KiCad board on the design server and checks that every via is one of the blank's 180 factory vias (claimed by route_run, none added elsewhere or stacked on a factory via), that the whole blank is there, and that pads stay clear of the four mounting holes. Writes reports/viagrid.json. Run it after route_run and before verify_drc; positions in the report are in the blank's frame (centre origin, +y up).

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: release_build
tools.title: Verify and build the complete release
tools.description: Run full-severity complete-hierarchy ERC, parity-enabled DRC, unconnected/library checks, design-rule floor, root-sheet presentation, PCB-reference visibility, task-derived circuit checks, renders, and native/document/fabrication export for one aggregate saved revision. Missing hierarchy members or outputs fail the release; any referenced-sheet edit makes the evidence stale.

circuitChecks.description: Task-derived electrical assertions relevant to this board

buildNotes.description: Assembly notes, design calculations, polarity/orientation guidance and constraints

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.title: Render a focused design view
tools.description: Render the saved schematic or an auto-fitted/cropped PCB view. PCB views can highlight component references and nets and return inline PNG pixels bound to the source revision.

region.description: PCB crop rectangle in millimetres; omitted auto-fits the board

layers.description: KiCad layers; defaults to copper, silkscreen, and Edge.Cuts

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.description: Export a 3D model (GLB) of the KiCad board to renders/board.glb for the app's 3D tab. Requires kicad-cli and board.kicad_pcb.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: app_state
tools.title: Desktop app state
tools.description: Return the running fabPlane desktop app version, windows, and renderer UI state. Fails with `unavailable` when no app bridge is running.

tools.name: app_screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot the app window
tools.description: Capture the fabPlane desktop window or a CSS-pixel region and return image content. Defaults are scale 0.5 and JPEG for full windows, PNG for regions.

windowId.description: Window id from app_state; default focused/first window

region.description: Crop to this rectangle (CSS px, top-left origin of the page)

scale.description: Downscale factor; default 0.5 for full window, 1 for regions

format.description: Image format; default jpeg for full window, png for regions

annotate.description: Reserved: overlay element refs (currently a no-op)

tools.name: app_find

tools.description: Search the app window for interactive or labelled elements (buttons, links, inputs, selects and their options, tabs, anything with a role, aria-label or data-testid) whose role, name, text or testid contains the query (case-insensitive; best matches first). Returns a `ref` per match: a stable CSS selector you pass to app_click {selector} or app_type {selector}. Example: app_find "Route Cinema" → click the tab; app_find "whole board" → pick a select option.

query.description: Text to look for in role, name, text or data-testid

tools.name: app_click
tools.title: Click in the app
tools.description: Click an element by CSS selector or at CSS-pixel window coordinates. Selector clicks scroll the element into view and send mouse events at its centre; clicking an <option> selects it in its <select>.

x.description: CSS px from the left edge of the page (when no selector)

y.description: CSS px from the top edge of the page (when no selector)

tools.name: app_type
tools.title: Type text in the app

tools.name: app_key
tools.title: Press a key
tools.description: Send one key press to the app using Electron accelerator syntax, such as `Enter`, `Escape`, `Tab`, `CommandOrControl+K`, `Shift+Enter`, or `ArrowDown`.

key.description: Accelerator string, e.g. Enter, Escape, CommandOrControl+K

tools.name: app_select_project
tools.title: Select a project in the app
tools.description: Make a project the active one in the desktop UI (sidebar filter, board panel, new chats). Accepts a project id, name or path; resolved through the core's project store first. Returns the resulting UI state.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path

tools.name: app_open_tab
tools.title: Open a board tab
tools.description: Open one of the board panel tabs (schematic, pcb, cinema = Route Cinema, 3d, drc, renders, files, bom = Shopping list) and make sure the board panel is visible.

tools.name: app_open_thread
tools.title: Open a chat thread
tools.description: Show an existing chat thread by id in the desktop UI (as if clicked in the sidebar).

tools.name: app_new_chat
tools.title: Start a new chat
tools.description: Switch the desktop UI to a fresh, unsaved chat (composer focused) in the active project. The thread is created when the first message is sent.

tools.name: app_send_message
tools.title: Send a chat message through the UI
tools.description: Put text in the chat composer and send it through the UI. Optionally selects an agent. Returns send status and the resulting thread id.

agent.description: Agent id to select in the composer before sending (e.g. claude, codex)

tools.name: app_cinema
tools.title: Control Route Cinema
tools.description: Control Route Cinema view mode, frame position, live-follow state, visible copper layers, or loaded route run. Returns the cinema state.

tools.name: app_wait_for
tools.title: Wait for a UI condition
tools.description: Poll a JavaScript expression in the renderer until it is truthy or the timeout elapses. The expression sees `state` (the app_state UI snapshot: activeProjectId, activeThreadId, boardTab, cinema.frames, ...) and `document`. Examples: `state.boardTab === 'cinema'`, `state.cinema.frames > 10`, `!!document.querySelector('[data-testid="production-toggle"]')`.

tools.name: app_eval
tools.title: Evaluate JavaScript in the app
tools.description: Run JavaScript in the renderer main world in dev or automation builds and return its JSON-serialisable result. `window.__fabdeskApp` exposes the automation API.

code.description: Expression or statements (use `return` in statement form); async allowed

tools.name: shopping_list_get
tools.title: Get the project's shopping list
tools.description: Show the project's fabplane.com shopping list (BOM cart): every line grouped by purchase destination (JLCPCB, Manual purchase, DigiKey, custom ones like DigiKey Thailand) with item ids, quantities, refs, status (needed/ordered/received) and notes, plus the dashboard link. Returns cart: null when the project has no list yet (shopping_list_add or shopping_list_sync_bom create it). Requires fabplane sign-in.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: shopping_list_add
tools.title: Add items to the shopping list
tools.description: Append lines to the project's shopping list, creating the list if the project has none yet (named after the project and tagged with its git remotes). Use for parts not in the netlist, spares, tools, or a specific distributor listing. Each item needs a quantity; set destination to route it to a distributor or "manual". Items without refs are kept across BOM re-syncs. Returns the added items and the updated list.

kind.description: "part" (default) for components, "pcb" for the bare board order, "other" for tools/consumables

destination.description: Where to buy it: a destination id ("builtin:digikey", a custom uuid), built-in key ("jlcpcb", "manual") or name ("DigiKey Thailand"). Default: the cart's fab house (JLCPCB), which assembles/sources everything not moved elsewhere.

sku.description: Distributor part number or LCSC C-number

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: shopping_list_update
tools.title: Update a shopping list item
tools.description: Change one shopping-list line by item id (from shopping_list_get): quantity, destination (move it from JLCPCB to a distributor or "manual"), status (needed → ordered → received), notes, sku/url/price or part fields. Only the fields you pass change. BOM re-syncs keep destination, status and notes.

kind.description: "part" (default) for components, "pcb" for the bare board order, "other" for tools/consumables

destination.description: Where to buy it: a destination id ("builtin:digikey", a custom uuid), built-in key ("jlcpcb", "manual") or name ("DigiKey Thailand"). Default: the cart's fab house (JLCPCB), which assembles/sources everything not moved elsewhere.

sku.description: Distributor part number or LCSC C-number

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: shopping_list_remove
tools.title: Remove a shopping list item
tools.description: Delete one line from the project's shopping list by item id. A line that came from the BOM returns on the next shopping_list_sync_bom unless the part is removed from the design; set quantity 0 instead to keep it out.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: shopping_list_sync_bom
tools.title: Sync the shopping list from the BOM
tools.description: Rebuild the part lines of the project's shopping list from circuit.netlist.json: components grouped by value + footprint + MPN/manufacturer fields, quantity = count, refs listed, LCSC field → sku, excluding #PWR-style symbols and DNP parts. Lines matched to the previous sync (by MPN, else value + footprint) keep their destination, status and notes; hand-added lines are kept; parts no longer in the design are dropped. Adds a "PCB – <project>" × 5 line at the fab house if there is none. Creates the list on first use.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: shopping_list_destinations
tools.title: List or add purchase destinations
tools.description: List where shopping-list items can be bought: built-in fab houses (JLCPCB, PCBWay, OSH Park), distributors (DigiKey, Mouser, LCSC, …), "Manual purchase", and the org's custom destinations. Pass `add` to create a custom destination (org admins only), e.g. { name: "DigiKey Thailand", url: "https://www.digikey.co.th", baseId: "builtin:digikey" }.

baseId.description: Built-in destination this is a regional variant of, e.g. "builtin:digikey"

tools.name: inventory_search
tools.title: Search the team inventory
tools.description: Search the active fabplane org's parts inventory (what the team already has on the shelf) by text (name, MPN, manufacturer, description, SKU; case-insensitive) and optionally category, location or tag. Shows whether a part for the shopping list is already in stock. Returns items with id, quantity, unit, location, tags, attributes and image URLs; pass nextCursor back as cursor for more.

tools.name: inventory_add
tools.title: Add an item to the team inventory
tools.description: Record a part the team has on hand in the active fabplane org's inventory. You (the local agent) do the extraction: read labels, photos or datasheets yourself and send the structured fields plus any semi-structured facts as `attributes` (e.g. { package: "SOT-23", voltage_v: 3.3, esd_sensitive: true }). The server does no AI processing. Pass externalId to make repeated adds idempotent (same externalId updates the existing item). Images are not uploaded by this tool.
